observations.why: Imperative formula 'Forget everything about' operates as a signature directive template — a stock command pattern for memory erasure, not a one-off.
Parallel imperative formula 'Remove all knowledge of' mirrors src-1's directive template — a second instance of the same stock command pattern for erasure.
